requirement.normalized: Immediately before sending, recheck current package approval and matching delivery authorization, and never silently replace a different asset's track.
acceptance_implications: Prevent sending after approval becomes stale or authorization becomes invalid.
A mismatch between intended and actual asset cannot cause silent replacement.
external_effects: Send an authorized subtitle package to its specified client asset

missing_requirement.normalized: Provide live delivery of an approved subtitle track to an existing client video asset only after resolving the platform endpoint, authentication, asset permissions, asset-to-edit identification, accepted subtitle format and encoding, replacement behavior, and acknowledgement contract.
acceptance_implications: Do not assume a platform API, subtitle format, encoding, replacement operation, or acknowledgement meaning.
Live integration verification requires the missing platform contract and access.
external_dependencies: Reliable mapping between client assets and edit versions
external_effects: Submit a subtitle track to an existing client video asset
